summary: The candidate is mathematically correct and complete. The affine residual-rank identity, lattice-coordinate reduction, and pullback of halfspaces establish the dominated-measure bound with the exact factor 1/[2^{rho_sigma}(r_sigma+1)]. The same-parity construction has mass B/2 and therefore the stated additional factor 1/2. In each parity class, the fractional matching leaves exactly max(2 beta_xi-B_xi,0), the unordered edge mass is one half of the total matched degree, and endpoint-indicator domination has no missing coefficient. The selector estimate bounds the total unmatched mass with the stated scaling, so all bounds (29)-(33), including positive-part and nonzero-measure cases, follow with the displayed powers of two. Boundary, zero-rank, singleton, empty-parity, and heavy-vertex cases are handled.
